text:
Ɛfiri 8 June kɔsi 8 July 1990 no, Italy na ɛhɔɔ FIFA World Cup no, na wɔaboabo 24 kɔɔp mu wɔ sɛnea ɛte sɛ: kɔpu nsia a ɛwɔ nnipa anan mu, na kɔpu biara mu nnipa a wɔdi kan mmienu ne nnipa a wɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa a wɔyɛ papa no nan na wɔkɔ 16-team single-elimination knockout stage a ɛfiri round of 16 kɔ quarter-finals, semi-finals, third-place match ne final. Wɔkaeɛ sɛ ɛyɛ kɔp a wɔkaeɛ no sɛ ɛwɔ ahobrɛaseɛ ne dram mu, na ɛyɛ record-low average a ɛyɛ 2.21 goals per match wɔ defensive, low-scoring play mu. Total attendance duruu 2,516,215 wɔ matches 52 so, average 48,389 per game.

Nsɛm no baeɛ ntɛm. Cameroon na ɛbuee kɔp no mu de defending champions Argentina dii nkunim, na ɛkɔɔ n’anim kɔyɛɛ Afrika man a edi kan kɔɔ World Cup quarter-final. Ɔman a ɛhɔɔ no nso hunuu ɔsɛmfoɔ a wɔanhwɛ n’anim, Salvatore Schillaci, na ne goals nsia de Italy kɔɔ third place na ɔnyaa Golden Boot sɛ top scorer ne Golden Ball sɛ tournament no mu ɔsɛmfoɔ papa. Lothar Matthaus nyaa Silver Ball na Diego Maradona nyaa Bronze Ball.

Knockout rounds no de tension baeɛ sen spectacle. England kɔɔ semi-finals ansa na West Germany adi nkunim wɔ penalties mu, na Britain kaeɛ saa kɔp no sɛnea ɛde Luciano Pavarotti ne ‘Nessun dorma’ a BBC coverage no de baeɛ no bɔɔ mu. Ɛyɛ anwonwa sɛ semi-finalists anan no, West Germany, Argentina, Italy ne England, nyinaa yɛ World Cup winners dada.

Final no wɔ Rome’s Stadio Olimpico, West Germany ne Argentina ntam, yɛɛ anibereɛ na ɛbɛyɛɛ World Cup final a edi kan a wɔde obi kɔɔ abɔnten, wɔde mmienu koraa, Argentina’s Pedro Monzon ne Gustavo Dezotti. Andreas Brehme na ɔde penalty a wɔde maa no wɔ 85th minute no, foul on Rudi Voller nti, de West Germany dii nkunim 1-0 na ɔnyaa title a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa. Saa nkunim no maa coach Franz Beckenbauer yɛɛ onipa a odi kan captain ne manager World Cup-winning team, na ɛyɛ nkonim a etwa toɔ wɔ ‘West Germany’ din no ase ansa na German reunification aba.
